categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Boshun Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of precision functional components and intelligent automation equipment. Its products serve consumer electronics such as smartphones, smart wearables, and smart home devices, as well as new energy and automotive sectors including smart cockpits, power batteries, and energy storage batteries, and also the smart medical field. The company is focusing on strategic transformation towards AR/VR, optical, and new energy industries, upgrading its diversified high-quality product and service system.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovation-driven R&D with advanced manufacturing technologies in precision components and intelligent automation. It employs automated production lines, precision visual positioning systems, and automated testing and assembly equipment. The company also develops proprietary technologies in battery auxiliary material production, automotive auxiliary equipment, and automated inspection systems, supported by extensive patents and software copyrights.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading manufacturers and component producers in consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, automotive smart cockpits, and smart medical devices. The company serves global markets with a focus on high-end applications in smartphones, wearables, AR/VR devices, and automotive batteries. The top five customers account for over 79% of sales, indicating a concentrated but strategic customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global operational footprint with headquarters in Shenzhen, China, and subsidiaries in multiple Chinese cities including Zhengzhou, Weifang, Chengdu, and overseas entities in Hong Kong and Vietnam. Domestic sales constitute about 76% of revenue, while overseas markets contribute approximately 24%, showing significant international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Boshun Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, R&D, manufacturing, and sales of precision components and automation equipment. It acts as a key supplier to downstream manufacturers in consumer electronics, automotive, and medical device industries, providing integrated product and solution services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in AR/VR, optical technologies, and new energy sectors, aiming to enhance product quality and market competitiveness. It maintains a strong innovation culture with over 370 patents and active participation in national and industry standards development. R&D projects focus on automation, precision testing, intelligent manufacturing, and digital transformation to support strategic industrial upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of manufactured precision functional components and intelligent automation equipment. The company operates on a make-to-order production model, signing framework agreements with customers and fulfilling orders based on specific product specifications, quantities, and delivery schedules. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a national high-tech enterprise with recognized technological and market advantages. It holds prestigious titles such as national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and Guangdong high-growth innovative enterprise. Its focus on high-value-added products and strategic transformation aims to strengthen its competitive edge in precision manufacturing and intelligent automation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.31 billion, a 22.49% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 211 million, down 17.35%. Despite revenue decline due to strategic adjustments and divestment of low-margin products, the company maintains positive cash flow and continues investing in R&D, with a workforce of 1,682 employees and a solid asset base of over RMB 3 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced technological capabilities, comprehensive R&D strength, and high-quality manufacturing processes to deliver precision and intelligent products tailored to customer needs. Its globalized market presence and integrated design-to-sales service model provide customized solutions across multiple high-growth sectors. Continuous innovation, quality management certifications, and strategic focus on emerging technologies differentiate it in competitive markets.
